quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's oral GLP-1, Foundayo (orforglipron), demonstrated (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lilly reported detailed results of the Phase 3 ACHIEVE-4 trial (presented at EASD and published in The Lancet), Foundayo's largest and longest type 2 diabetes study, versus titrated insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight at increased cardiovascular risk. Foundayo met the primary objective of non-inferiority on MACE-4 (16% lower risk, hazard ratio 0.84; 95.0% CI: 0.59 to 1.20; non-inferiority margin upper limit < 1.8), with MACE-3 23% lower (hazard ratio 0.77; 95.0% CI: 0.52 to 1.13); in pre-planned analyses not controlled for type 1 error, cardiovascular death was 53% lower (hazard ratio 0.47) and all-cause death 57% lower (hazard ratio 0.43). At 52 weeks A1C fell 1.6% versus 1.0% from a mean baseline of 8.22% and body weight changed -8.8% versus +1.7%; at 104 weeks (not controlled for type 1 error) 54.6% versus 23.8% reached A1C of 6.5% or lower and 35.9% versus 3.4% achieved at least 10% weight reduction. Foundayo also reduced hsCRP by 38.9%, triglycerides by 18.9% and systolic blood pressure by 4.4 mmHg, with a 27.1% greater reduction in albuminuria. 10.6% of Foundayo participants discontinued due to adverse events during the 52-week minimum treatment period. Lilly is running ATTAIN-OUTCOMES, an ongoing Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes study in adults with obesity or overweight with established cardiovascular or kidney disease.
